prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1200; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in at an intersection in League City, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were traveling and what the traffic signal showed for you?

A: I was heading through the intersection on the main road. The light had been green for a while, I think. I was going at the normal speed for that stretch.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. It came from the cross street, and I only noticed it when it was almost on me. I braked, but there wasn't time to stop.

Q: Where did the impact land on your vehicle?

A: On the driver's side, toward the back door. The other car hit me at an angle.

Q: Did you get out of the car and speak with anyone at the scene?

A: I got out, yes. The other driver and I exchanged information. Someone at the scene asked if I was hurt and I said my lower back hurt, but I thought I'd walk it off.

Q: When did you first seek medical attention?

A: A couple of days later, because the pain kept getting worse. I went to a clinic and they diagnosed a back strain. I've been doing physical therapy since then.

Q: Are you currently having any limitations at work or in daily activities?

A: Lifting is hard, and I can't sit for long periods. I've had to adjust how I drive, too.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
